This workbook belongs with **Unit N of the A1 Spanish course** (*Title*). Instructions are in English; the Spanish is the level you are learning.

> **Theory guide:** [Title](/blog/curso-espanol-a1/unidad-N-slug)

Do each block **without** opening the answer. Then read the explanation—not only the key.

**In this unit:**
1. [Lesson 1 — Grammar](#lesson-1--grammar)
2. [Lesson 2 — Vocabulary](#lesson-2--vocabulary)
3. [Lesson 3 — Reading](#lesson-3--reading)
4. [Lesson 4 — Listening](#lesson-4--listening)
5. [Lesson 5 — Writing](#lesson-5--writing)

## Lesson 2 — Vocabulary

**Goal:** the unit lexical set, with gender.

### Exercises 1–15

Mix matching, gender, collocations, and “which noun does not fit”.

Every noun in the key must show **el/la**.

---

**Goal:** understand a short text that recycles this unit’s grammar and vocabulary.

### Text

(80–140 words at A1; gloss only the new items.)

### Questions 1–10

Detail, reference, and one inference that stays inside A1.

**Goal:** catch the target form in a short dialogue.

## Lesson 5 — Writing

**Goal:** the unit can-do in 4–8 sentences.

1. Prompt in English (situation).  
2. Planning box (words you must use).  
3. Five sentence-repair items.  
4. **Model answer** in Spanish + commentary in English (why *tener* not *ser*, agreement, etc.).

---

*Body must be ≥ 2,000 words: commented answers, reading text, model writing, and contrast notes supply the length. Do not add empty headings.*
